title: 宇树已售数千台：全在商业场景，客户为何持续复购？
speaker: Jesse Liu

segments.en: Yes. So all those show kind of the dexterity, they show the endurance, they show the functionality in outside environments, in extreme heat. The sort of the scalability of the brain system, that's methodology and data. Those storeings are connected. We're experimenting with those at a very rapid pace.
segments.zh: 这些都展示了灵活性、耐久性和在极端环境下的功能。大脑系统的可扩展性涉及方法论和数据，这些是相互关联的。我们正在快速实验。

segments.en: Last time I was here as an April, we still don't have a lot of the new methodologies that we're using today, so it's only been four months. And I think our methodology has moved forward quite a bit. Is it the most finalized version of that methodology and the data type that's needed, probably not? But I think we're on a more promising direction than even half a year, a quarter ago, I'd say.
segments.zh: 上次我来是四月份，当时还没有今天使用的很多新方法，仅仅四个月，我们的方法论已经进步了很多。这是否是最终版本？可能不是，但我认为我们正走在更有希望的方向上，比半年前、一个季度前更好。

segments.en: Do you think that you've made enough progress to actually significantly scale up commercially now? I think we're demonstrating some sort of... We're proving that exponential potential, that we usually experience with new AI waves. And usually when that exponential curve isn't really speeding up, it's because we haven't found the right methods. When we're on the right track, that curve really starts boosting up. So I think we're on that curve now. So...
segments.zh: 你认为现在是否取得了足够进展，可以大规模商业化？我们正在证明指数级潜力，这是新AI浪潮中常见的。通常指数曲线没有加速是因为方法不对。当我们走上正轨，曲线就会飙升。我认为我们现在就在这条曲线上。

segments.en: Can I ask, how many have you sold? How many are in commercial operation among your clients? Yeah, so we've sold up until today in the thousands of units. And we're quite proud, because those thousands of units are actually in, we call it, real commercial scenarios. Sure, yeah. Nothing to do with data collection. Nothing to do with... They're in scenarios that actually help that give value to our customers. Not a lot of work done in living rooms and households today, yet, but they're working commercial.
segments.zh: 能问一下你们卖了多少台？客户中有多少在商业运营？到目前为止，我们已售出数千台。我们很自豪，因为这些数千台都在真实的商业场景中，与数据收集无关。它们为客户创造价值。目前家庭场景还不多，但它们在商业领域工作。
